name: PEERYX NETWORK SAS
name_long: PEERYX NETWORK - DDoS Protected IP Transit
notes:
Peeryx Network is a French infrastructure and network security operator delivering Anti-DDoS protected IP Transit, BGP connectivity and secure traffic delivery solutions.
Our network is designed for hosting providers, game server operators and businesses requiring resilient, low-latency and DDoS-protected connectivity.
We support interconnection via cross-connects, GRE/IPIP/VXLAN tunnels and BGP sessions.

Contact us for peering, transit, capacity or interconnection opportunities.
